['Fielmann AG '].company_description: Fielmann Group AG is a German eyewear company. The Fielmann stock is listed in the German SDAX index and at the northern German regional HASPAX index. With 5% of all optical stores, Fielmann achieved a 22% sales market share and a 53% market share in terms of units sold. Fielmann is market leader in Germany and Europe's largest optician. Marc David Günther Fielmann known as Marc Fielmann (born 24 July 1989) is a German businessman and optometrist. He is the CEO of Fielmann Group, the leading European eyewear provider which was founded by his father Günther Fielmann. Fielmann was Germany's youngest CEO when appointed only aged 29. Günther Klaus Fielmann known as Günther Fielmann (born 17 September 1939) is a German billionaire businessman, the founder, majority owner and the former chief executive officer of Fielmann, a German optics company focusing on retail eyewear. As of August 2021, his net worth is estimated at US$5.8 billion Since 2019, the management of Fielmann Group, was handed over completely to his son Marc Fielmann.
